evidence: numerical-uncalibrated simulation (round 4); demo = engineering illustration; nothing physically tested

fullrun.name: Full run (shared): set-down take-off at the top → ride 38 s → rest 20 s → ride 33 s → stop at the lift and pick up; 6 m/s crosswind (representative case; judged on the 48-case ensemble)
fullrun.expect: Head-on lead flight; when the rider stops it lands ahead and waits filming; at the push-off it takes off at once; at the end it stays down to be picked up. Judged on the ensemble: avail, standstill p90, actions, peak force, KE, endurance.

events.en: Set down on the snow beside the skis: wings spring open; once the rider stands up it starts its own skid-run take-off (no hand toss)
Lift-off at 5.3 m/s, 2.2 m ahead of the rider

nominal.name: Nominal: 12 m/s carving, light wind (single case, for comparison)
nominal.expect: Lead and film head-on; a 12–13 m/s rider is too fast for mid-ride perches. Fail: falls behind, KE >14.9 J.

nominal_ld70.name: Nominal with L/D −30 % (sensitivity)
nominal_ld70.expect: Shared glider rule: L/D −30 %. Motor energy needed, still ahead?

slow.name: Slow rider (5 m/s, 10° slope): leapfrog perching
slow.expect: At low speed a ≥2.5 s approach shot is predicted: perch, film, hop; every 2nd perch the rider passes ≥5 m to the side.

short.expect: Quick edge changes: the lead holds; turret and post framing must follow larger azimuth swings.

fast.name: High speed 16 m/s (expected envelope failure)
fast.expect: Rider downhill speed above the KE cap: the glider drops behind and keeps flying alongside, mostly back views/blocked. A failure marks the envelope.

headwind.name: Upslope headwind 6 m/s (gusty)
headwind.expect: Lead flight needs more airspeed: motor power and attitude disturbance.

crossgust.name: Crosswind 6 m/s + 7 m/s gust
crossgust.expect: Lane keeping and footage stability in gusts (seed spread: see the ensemble).

perchwind.name: Perch in strong wind: 8 m/s cross + 4 m/s downslope, gusts to ~16 m/s
perchwind.expect: Perch wind limit: claws, wing-tip skids, feathered downforce. Fail: blown off or tipped.

events.en: Estimated wind 12.5 m/s outside the flight envelope: stays perched, takes off once it eases

gentle.name: Gentle 6° slope (9 m/s)
gentle.expect: Gravity no longer pays the cruise: motor energy and endurance.

fall.name: Rider fall at 12 m/s
fall.expect: At the fall the glider is ahead: it lands and films from the front; no strike risk.

events.en: Fallen rider pose not modelled; the glider sits ahead, results are geometric only
Perch #1: claws in, tail pan/tilt camera on the uphill rider

neighbour.expect: Perch-site selection avoids the other skier; when perched it hops off early and moves outwards.

powder.name: Soft/fresh snow perch (envelope): take-off fails
powder.expect: Sinks 8 cm, ploughing drag exceeds thrust: stranded, must be picked up and set down again. Judged normally (an envelope condition, not a fault).

events.en: Perch #1: claws in, tail pan/tilt camera on the uphill rider
Take-off failed (powder ploughing drag exceeds thrust): waiting to be collected

ice.name: Icy piste (envelope): rider stops from 12 m/s, the glider lands on ice
ice.expect: Ice: claw drag μ≈0.35, anchor 0.5 N (ASSUMED): long slide after touchdown on 15°, possibly beyond 50 m.

events.en: Perch #1: claws in, tail pan/tilt camera on the uphill rider

motorfail.name: Motor failure during lead flight
motorfail.expect: Without power it still glides and lands safely (fail-safe = land on snow) but cannot take off again.

launch.expect: Draw, wings spring open, set down on the snow: once the rider stands up it runs away from the rider, lifts off and climbs into the lead; ≥1 m from the helmet (shared headClear).

launch_toss.name: Comparison: iteration-2 one-hand toss (too close to the head)
launch_toss.expect: Released 0.4 m in front of the chest: the airborne glider passes <1 m from the helmet, headClear fails — hence the set-down launch.

events.en: One-hand toss: wings spring open, pusher motor starts

tail6_bypass.name: Envelope: 6 m/s downslope wind, progress gate bypassed (launch anyway)
tail6_bypass.expect: The gate would refuse. Launched anyway: KE-feasible crab, airbrake and GNSS land-now keep KE under 14.9 J, but it cannot keep up, lands before the 50 m follow-me radius and is left behind (+1 recovery).

ensemble.rules: round 4: 48 cases (FULLRUN_CASES_R4); avail = mean of 48 on col.riding (no-fly = 0), frames judged on footage().bodyPx ≥300 px; jitter = p90 over flown cases of footageStability(R).subjectRms with the LIVE tracker crop; setup p90 simulated (MODAPTS gloved set-down + gate wait + lead wait + landing wait + skate/side-step + MODAPTS gloved pick-up/snap); ops p90 (max reported); keMax/bodyForce max; headClear min (helmetAt); all wind gates on windEstimate()

endurance.rule: shared enduranceMin(cell + bank×0.85, mean full-run power of the flown cases, heated: heater charged over the whole day) — cold 0.75, reserve 15 %

envelope2D.note: gate geometry: sustained track (≤2.5 m/s drift across the piste) with downhill progress ≥ the rider's, thrust + slope gravity, 1.12 v_stall floor (best of tucked/extended), 3-D ground speed ≤ vCapG − 0.3; downslope wind + = tail. Judged gate also adds +0.4 m/s and a ±1 m/s cross-slope box.

tailBound.note: max tail wind for a straight downwind lead under the KE cap (gate margins 1.0 m/s): w_max = (√(2·14.9/m) − 1.0)/cos θ·… − 1.12 v_stall
tailBound.convexHullNote: upper bound on mean downhill progress by alternating crab legs on the cap circle (no turn losses): (c² − Va² + w²)/(2w); rider needs ≈10.9 m/s

exposure.note: expected other-skier passes per run, rate = density × 10 m/s × 2r × time; densities ASSUMED; detection 80 % ASSUMED
